description:
One deposit of the wallet by its token: status pending → paid (credited,
        bonus included) | underpaid (nothing credited yet, the rest can still arrive) |
        payment_held (the payment processor's compliance check stopped the payment and
        holds it: nothing is credited, do not pay again, the person should write to
        support) | expired. Poll every ~30 s after sending; crypto needs the network's
        confirmations. Needs the wallet code.
name: get_deposit
